title: TableRollDetail
description:
One cell of the row a `TableRoll` landed on.

Pairs the column header with the cell's content, plus any rolls triggered by references inside
that content — which is what makes a roll a tree rather than a flat result.

- SeeAlso: `TableRoll`

name.description:
The header of the column this cell came from.

## Examples
- `"Magic Item"`

value.description:
The cell's content, with any inline dice macros already rolled.

## Examples
- `"[Bag of holding](item)"`
- `"3 gems worth 50 gp each"` — after a `2d4` macro was resolved

rolls.description:
Rolls produced by table references inside `value`.

A reference preceded by a dice expression is rolled that many times, so one cell can yield
several rolls on the same table.
